$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. ProvingTests is named but never specified in the source pack (WP-1 task brief §6) — designed here: a container for the detailed proving-test entries an AssayIndex.provingTests summary (schemas/integrations/assay-index.v1.schema.json) points at, living at runs/<runId>/proving-tests.v1.json alongside the generated sources at tests/proving/. A proving test is what INCIDENT_SOURCE_AND_PROOF_CONTRACT.md's proof-gated resolution (INT-021) can accept as satisfying the proof requirement for an Assay-sourced Incident. schemaVersion pinned to major 1, FB-RAT-COM-003.
title: ProvingTests
description: Container for one Assay run's proving-test entries. `runId` MUST equal the owning AssayIndex.runId this file is filed under — the two are always read together, never independently trusted.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this container shape. A reader MUST reject any schemaVersion whose major is not '1' with IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED_MAJOR (FB-RAT-COM-003).

runId.description: MUST equal the owning AssayIndex.runId (INT-019's dedupe key) — this file has no independent identity apart from the run that produced it.

tests.description: May be empty — a run that found nothing provable yet (e.g. all findings are informational) is legitimate.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

ProvingTestKind.description: What kind of generated test proves/disproves the linked finding. EXPLOIT_POC is a minimal reproduction, not a weaponized artifact — Assay owns what it generates (SOLE finding/proof source rule); this schema only describes the shape.

ProvingTestStatus.description: PASSING/FAILING require the test to have actually run at least once (see the if/then below forcing lastRunAtUtc). NOT_RUN is the only status legitimately paired with a null lastRunAtUtc.

testId.description: Stable ID for this proving test, independent of sourcePath (FB-RAT-COM-002) — the same value a SARIF result's `properties.provingTestRef` (docs/ratified/ASSAY_REPO_CONTRACT_V1.md's SARIF profile) points back at.

targetFindingRef.description: Reference to the SARIF result this test proves or disproves, e.g. 'findings.sarif#/runs/0/results/12' or the underlying scanner's own stable rule+location key. Assay's own choice of reference scheme; Core treats it as opaque.

sourcePath.description: Path relative to the repo root, under tests/proving/, to the generated test source. A reader MUST reject any path containing a '..' segment before opening it (same LOCAL_FS path-traversal obligation as schemas/common/artifact-ref.schema.json).

lastRunAtUtc.description: Required (non-null) whenever status is not NOT_RUN — a test cannot be reported PASSING/FAILING/ERROR without having actually run once (structurally enforced below).
